title: Car Detection
description: Detect cars in an image with a YOLO-based object detection model.
long_description: This Studio Accelerator provides general guidance on how to develop a Computer Vision project for car detection with an RGB camera. The included YOLO-based starter model uses a single class (car) and can be adapted to parking lots, roads, robots, or other camera setups by adding representative data.
